os_version: Windows 11 Pro 26100, portable Temurin JDK 21 (no admin), live in-use machine
app: Swing probe app — the Java tier (DEEPENING-PLAN P2): UIA shape + coverage-guard + the Java Access Bridge channel end-to-end

stack_detection.signature: SunAwtFrame window class (=Java/AWT, a-priori); channel signature: jabswitch enabled + windowsaccessbridge-64.dll present + isJavaWindow(hwnd)=TRUE answers immediately once the JVM runs with the AccessBridge AT loaded

channel_setup: jabswitch -enable (per-user, no admin) + JVM flag -Djavax.accessibility.assistive_technologies=com.sun.java.accessibility.AccessBridge; client = 60-line ctypes over windowsaccessbridge-64.dll (Windows_run + full message pump + isJavaWindow/getAccessibleContextFromHWND/getAccessibleContextInfo walk).

t1_read_text.detail: Full Swing tree via JAB in 21.7 ms: frame > root/layered panes > panels > label/text/push-button/label, names + roles + rects. Honest caveat from our own probe design: we overrode the labels' accessible NAMES (setAccessibleName('sentinel-label')), which MASKS their text in the name field — the un-renamed button shows its text ('Increment') as expected; deeper text needs the AccessibleText API (not driven here).

t2_enumerate.detail: 10 nodes with roles (frame, root pane, layered pane, panel, label, text, push button) and bounding boxes.

t3_live_value.detail: AccessibleText/value APIs not driven in the minimal client — recorded as the known next step, not a channel limit.

t5_blind_action.detail: JAB exposes boxes (clickable via SendInput) and accessibleAction; not exercised in the minimal client.

t6_pictorial.detail: The DUAL story is the cell's value. UIA sees a Swing window as the Heaven shape: 7 nodes of pure window chrome, 4.6% coverage, content invisible. Coverage-guard initially found NO suspect — a frame-only tree offers no container to check, the guard's own blind spot, FOUND AND FIXED here: when coverage ~0 the router synthesizes the whole client area as suspect; energy 0.186 -> '[pixels] group ... client-area [unverified: pixels show content]'. So even before JAB, the blind spot is explicit; with JAB, it becomes structured.

measurements.notes: The Java tier, measured on both sides. UIA: 52 tok of window chrome, content-blind (the third custom-renderer family after Delphi/JUCE — except Java SHIPS its own structured channel). JAB: detection is a-priori (SunAwtFrame + dll + jabswitch state), the handshake needs two things our first attempt missed and the cell now documents: the JVM must load the AccessBridge AT (the explicit -Djavax.accessibility flag is more reliable than .accessibility.properties), and the client must pump ALL window messages, not just the bridge's private range (first run: isJavaWindow=false from a starved pump). Guard improvement shipped: synthesize_client_suspect for frame-only trees — Heaven-class windows now also get their client area declared instead of merely being 'unambiguously empty'.

runtime_verification.method: PrintWindow capture vs UIA view (chrome-only confirmed) vs JAB tree (content confirmed); guard crop saved
runtime_verification.agreement: three-way consistent: pixels show content, UIA honestly shows none, JAB shows the structure the pixels paint

permissions_required: none (jabswitch is per-user; portable JDK, no admin)
